section_summary: This section records Japanese merchant vessel movements reported by U.S. diplomatic and consular posts in January and early February 1941. Most reports are telegrams paired with paraphrases sent to the Navy; they track ports, sailing dates, routes, passengers and cargo. A few memoranda address reporting procedures, and a confidential exchange concerns passengers and health documents aboard the Arabia Maru.

people.name: H. D. Bode
people.role: U.S. Navy captain and head of the Foreign Intelligence Branch

people.name: Foster
people.role: U.S. consul general at São Paulo

subfiles.title: Azuma Maru at Barranquilla
subfiles.about: Reports the Azuma Maru sailing from Barranquilla toward New York, Boston and Philadelphia.
subfiles.summary: The Japanese ship arrived from Panama on January 23 and planned to sail that day.

subfiles.title: Atago Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Atago Maru's arrival at Callao and intended Chilean and Peruvian calls.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Salaverry and was to depart at midnight.

subfiles.title: Atago Maru at Callao: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Atago Maru's Callao arrival and planned route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Norweb's January 24 telegram.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Pernambuco
subfiles.about: Reports the Seia Maru sailing from Pernambuco toward Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: The vessel arrived from Santos and departed via Ceará, Pará, La Guaira and the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Pernambuco: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru's Pernambuco departure and intermediate stops.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Linthicum's January 24 report.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Montevideo Maru's arrival and planned departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 21 and was due to leave January 26 via the Panama Canal.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru at Buenos Aires: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Montevideo Maru's Buenos Aires schedule and Los Angeles destination.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases the January 25 embassy telegram.

subfiles.title: Kasima Maru at Karachi
subfiles.about: Reports the Kasima Maru's Karachi call and onward ports.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Bombay January 22 and sailed January 24 for Yokohama through Asian ports.

subfiles.title: Kasima Maru at Karachi: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Kasima Maru's Karachi dates and intended calls.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase warns that its listed ports are not in sailing order.

subfiles.title: Keyokawa Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Keyokawa Maru's arrival from Arica and planned voyage to Kobe.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 23 and was to depart January 26 via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Keyokawa Maru at Valparaíso: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Keyokawa Maru's Valparaíso call and departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Burt's January 25 report.

subfiles.title: Melbourne Maru and Kasima Maru sailings
subfiles.about: Reports departures from Bombay toward Kobe.
subfiles.summary: The Melbourne Maru sailed January 27; the Kasima Maru was scheduled for January 28.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential printer transmission of the accompanying vessel report.
subfiles.summary: The marked classification is confidential.

subfiles.title: Melbourne Maru and Kasima Maru: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the two Bombay departure reports.
subfiles.summary: The Melbourne Maru left for Kobe via Singapore; the Kasima Maru would follow via Manila and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Japanese vessel movements from Auckland
subfiles.about: Lists scheduled Japanese merchant sailings and describes Auckland reporting arrangements.
subfiles.summary: Groeninger lists February and March sailings for the Naniwa, Yamahuku, Atuta, Suwa and Sydney Maru. He says future reports will go by air mail and that irregular chartered vessels no longer call at Auckland.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Manzanillo: corrected telegram
subfiles.about: Reports the Ginyo Maru's cargo, passengers and departure from Manzanillo.
subfiles.summary: The corrected copy gives its fluorspar cargo as 1,000 tons.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential transmission of the corrected Ginyo Maru report.
subfiles.summary: A Simplex printer transmission form.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru: corrected Navy copy
subfiles.about: Corrects the Ginyo Maru's fluorspar quantity.
subfiles.summary: Reports 1,000 tons of fluorspar, 15 tons of mercury and passenger changes before departure for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru at Manzanillo: original telegram
subfiles.about: Reports the Ginyo Maru's Manzanillo call with an erroneous fluorspar figure.
subfiles.summary: The original states 100,000 tons of fluorspar; a corrected copy elsewhere gives 1,000.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential transmission of the original Ginyo Maru paraphrase.
subfiles.summary: A Simplex printer transmission form.

subfiles.title: Ginyo Maru: original Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the original, erroneous Ginyo Maru cargo report.
subfiles.summary: It repeats the 100,000 ton fluorspar figure later corrected to 1,000 tons.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru and Maruto Maru at Punta Arenas
subfiles.about: Reports calls and routes of two Japanese ships at Punta Arenas.
subfiles.summary: The Goyo Maru arrived January 26 and the Maruto Maru January 27.

subfiles.title: Punta Arenas vessel movements: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Goyo Maru and Maruto Maru movements.
subfiles.summary: Gives their arrival dates and planned calls at Balboa and South American ports.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru departure from Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the Brisbane Maru sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The Santos vice consul reports a January 25 departure via South African ports.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Requests confidential transmission of the Brisbane Maru report.
subfiles.summary: A Simplex printer transmission form.

subfiles.title: Brisbane Maru departure: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Brisbane Maru's January 25 departure from Santos.
subfiles.summary: Its destination was Japan via South African ports.

subfiles.title: Norway Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Norway Maru's Callao call and onward route.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Cerro Azul and was leaving for Chancay, Huacho and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Arabia Maru's Singapore call en route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Lourenço Marques January 25 and reportedly sailed via Cebu January 26.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Requests restricted transmission of the Arabia Maru report.
subfiles.summary: The marked classification is restricted.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru at Singapore: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Arabia Maru's arrival and reported departure.
subfiles.summary: It says the vessel left for Japan via Cebu the day after arriving.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru and Atago Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese ship calls at Antofagasta.
subfiles.summary: The Sagami Maru sailed for Taltal; the second vessel is called 'ATAZO MARU' in this report.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Provides a printer transmission form for the Antofagasta report.
subfiles.summary: No classification box is visibly marked.

subfiles.title: Antofagasta vessel movements: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Sagami Maru and 'Atazo Maru' movements.
subfiles.summary: Gives Antofagasta arrivals, the Sagami Maru's departure and the other ship's projected March 2 sailing.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru at Montevideo
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamazato Maru's Montevideo call and planned route.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Santos and would visit Buenos Aires before returning and sailing for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru at Montevideo: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamazato Maru's itinerary through Buenos Aires and Montevideo.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Wilson's January 29 telegram.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the Rakuyo Maru's cargo and passenger changes at Manzanillo.
subfiles.summary: The consular message is garbled on the arrival date and description of 80 tons loaded for South America.

subfiles.title: Rakuyo Maru at Manzanillo: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Rakuyo Maru's Manzanillo call while identifying telegram garbles.
subfiles.summary: It reports 41 passengers leaving, three boarding and a January 29 sailing for Acapulco.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru departure from Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamazato Maru's departure for Buenos Aires.
subfiles.summary: The Santos vice consul gives January 27 as the sailing date.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru departure: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamazato Maru's departure from Santos.
subfiles.summary: It departed for Buenos Aires on January 27.

subfiles.title: Azumasan Maru departure from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports a projected Azumasan Maru sailing for Japan.
subfiles.summary: The intended route was via Karachi and Rangoon.

subfiles.title: Navy transmission slip
subfiles.about: Provides a printer transmission form for the Azumasan Maru report.
subfiles.summary: No classification box is visibly marked.

subfiles.title: Azumasan Maru departure: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Azumasan Maru's planned Bombay departure.
subfiles.summary: Clarifies the projected date as January 31.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru at Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the Hie Maru's cargo and passengers at Manzanillo.
subfiles.summary: It loaded 370 tons of fluorspar and seven passengers before sailing for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Hie Maru at Manzanillo: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Hie Maru's Manzanillo call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Acapulco January 29 and was to depart for Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Pará
subfiles.about: Reports the Seia Maru's Pará call and planned route to Japan.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 29 from Fortaleza and departed January 31 via La Guaira, Panama and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at Pará: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru's Pará departure.
subfiles.summary: Its destinations were Yokohama and Kobe via La Guaira, Panama Canal ports and Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Lima Maru's Singapore call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Rangoon January 29 and sailed for Hong Kong January 30.

subfiles.title: Lima Maru at Singapore: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Lima Maru's arrival and departure dates.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's January 31 report.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru passengers and health documents
subfiles.about: Reports discrepancies in the Arabia Maru's passenger records, destination and health documents.
subfiles.summary: The Cebu health documents stated that no passengers boarded at Singapore, but official information said 74 Japanese did. The ship sought Cebu charts, reportedly changed its Philippine destination to Manila and sailed without notifying the consulate or obtaining a Manila bill of health.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru confidential report: paraphrase
subfiles.about: Relays the Arabia Maru report received through Manila.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase describes 74 Japanese passengers allegedly embarked at Singapore despite contrary health documents. It also records a refused request for Cebu charts and an unreported change of destination to Manila.

subfiles.title: Arabia Maru report to Navy Central Division
subfiles.about: Forwards the Arabia Maru paraphrase for Commander McCollum's attention.
subfiles.summary: Wilson links the enclosure to McCollum's January 29 telephone call about Japanese vessel reporting.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru at Guayaquil
subfiles.about: Reports the Goyo Maru's Guayaquil arrival and onward sailing.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from the Canal Zone and was to sail that evening for Callao and points south.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru at Guayaquil: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Goyo Maru's Guayaquil call.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Nester's February 1 telegram.

subfiles.title: Instructions on Japanese vessel reporting
subfiles.about: Explains a delay in carrying out instructions on Japanese vessel reports.
subfiles.summary: Grew says a lapse kept earlier instructions from consular officers; they have now been instructed.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru departure from Santos
subfiles.about: Reports the Montevideo Maru's Santos call and route to Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 20 from Rio Grande and sailed February 1 via Brazilian, Venezuelan and Panama Canal ports.

subfiles.title: Montevideo Maru from Santos: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Montevideo Maru's Santos departure and projected stops.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Foster's February 3 telegram.

subfiles.title: Atago Maru and Kiyokawa Maru at Antofagasta
subfiles.about: Reports departures of two Japanese ships and their cargoes.
subfiles.summary: The Atago Maru sailed via Los Angeles for Yokohama; the Kiyokawa Maru sailed via San Francisco for Kobe.

subfiles.title: Antofagasta sailings and cargoes: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Atago Maru and Kiyokawa Maru departures and mineral cargoes.
subfiles.summary: The paraphrase assigns copper cargo to the Kiyokawa Maru and lead, antimony, silver and copper to the Atago Maru, noting an omission.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Valparaíso
subfiles.about: Reports the Sagami Maru's Valparaíso call and departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Taltal January 31 and sailed February 4 for Hong Kong via Los Angeles.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru at Valparaíso: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Sagami Maru's voyage toward Hong Kong.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Burt's February 4 report.

subfiles.title: Tenerife tanker reporting request
subfiles.from: H. D. Bode, Office of Naval Intelligence
subfiles.to: Orme Wilson, State Department liaison officer
subfiles.about: Requests expanded reporting of tanker movements at Tenerife.
subfiles.summary: The Navy asks that reports include Portuguese and Standard Oil tankers under Panama's flag exceeding 2,000 gross tons.

subfiles.title: Sagami Maru munitions for Peru
subfiles.from: J. W. Thomason Jr., Navy Department
subfiles.about: Reports munitions aboard the Sagami Maru consigned to Peru.
subfiles.summary: A Honolulu message listed 660 cases of ammunition and 38 cases of detonators destined for Peru's War Ministry.

subfiles.title: Kasima Maru at Colombo
subfiles.about: Reports the Kasima Maru's Colombo call and probable departure.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 31 and was believed to have sailed February 3 for Manila via Singapore.

subfiles.title: Sumatra Maru departure from Bombay
subfiles.about: Reports the Sumatra Maru's planned sailing for Kobe.
subfiles.summary: Departure was expected February 9 via Karachi, Singapore and Shanghai.

subfiles.title: Sumatra Maru departure: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Sumatra Maru's projected Bombay departure and route.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Donovan's February 5 telegram.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru at Singapore
subfiles.about: Reports the Haruna Maru's Singapore call and route to Karachi.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Hong Kong February 3 and sailed February 4 via Penang, Colombo and Bombay.

subfiles.title: Haruna Maru at Singapore: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Haruna Maru's arrival and departure from Singapore.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Patton's February 5 telegram.

subfiles.title: Goyo Maru at Callao
subfiles.about: Reports the Goyo Maru's Callao arrival and onward sailing.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Guayaquil February 4 and was leaving for Arica and Valparaíso.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru departure from Manzanillo
subfiles.about: Reports the Takaoka Maru's cargo and departure for Los Angeles.
subfiles.summary: It left February 4 after loading mercury, fluorspar and cotton waste.

subfiles.title: Takaoka Maru: Navy transmission copy
subfiles.about: Copies the Takaoka Maru report for Navy transmission.
subfiles.summary: Repeats the February 4 sailing and quantities of mercury, fluorspar and cotton waste.

subfiles.title: Yamasiro Maru and Atlas Maru from Yokohama
subfiles.about: Reports two Japanese freighter departures from Yokohama.
subfiles.summary: The Yamasiro Maru sailed for Davao via Palau; a port list showed the Atlas Maru cleared for Bombay.

subfiles.title: Yokohama freighter departures: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Yamasiro Maru and Atlas Maru departures.
subfiles.summary: The Atlas Maru's type and tonnage were unknown.

subfiles.title: Hakone Maru at Karachi
subfiles.about: Reports the Hakone Maru's Karachi arrival and planned route.
subfiles.summary: It arrived February 4 from Bombay and was leaving February 6 along the Kasima Maru route, omitting Kamman.

subfiles.title: Hakone Maru at Karachi: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Hakone Maru's Karachi call and onward ports.
subfiles.summary: Lists Bombay, Colombo, Singapore, Manila, Shanghai, Kobe, Osaka and Yokkaichi en route to Yokohama.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at La Guaira
subfiles.about: Reports the Seia Maru's La Guaira call.
subfiles.summary: It arrived from Panama February 5 and sailed for eastern South American ports February 6.

subfiles.title: Seia Maru at La Guaira: Navy copy
subfiles.about: Relays the Seia Maru's La Guaira arrival and departure.
subfiles.summary: Paraphrases Moessner's February 6 telegram.

subfiles.title: Yamazato Maru at Buenos Aires
subfiles.about: Reports the Yamazato Maru's Buenos Aires call and route toward Japan.
subfiles.summary: It arrived January 30 and sailed February 6 for Los Angeles and Kobe via the Panama Canal.
